decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing is a commoditised, non-core service facing strong competition from cloud collaboration platforms, but it still complements the firm's voice portfolio and is likely kept for now.
Metro data centre connectivity is core to the firm's fibre and data centre strategy and already shows customer adoption in financial hubs.
Optical spectrum services use the firm's owned fibre for high-bandwidth customers and are prominently featured, fitting its strategic direction.
A self-service number ordering portal supports the push toward real-time provisioning and costs little to maintain.
Carrier pre-selection is a declining legacy telephony service, but it still earns revenue from existing customers and will probably not be withdrawn within a year.
Direct voice network connections suit enterprise and service-provider customers moving to SIP and cloud voice, so the service stays relevant.
